Kancelářská tiskárna OKI B433dn vyniká v nákladech a robustnosti. Red Hat představil nástroj pro hodnocení připravenosti organizací na digitální suverenitu. Pro AI i bezpečnost znamená zásadní změnu OpenClaw, síť Moltbook je spíše třešnička na dortu. N‑able zvyšuje kybernetickou odolnost díky integrovaným AI funkcím.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Umělá inteligence ve třídě – učitelé bijí na poplach, ale nevzdávají se technologií

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 8/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Bohatství organických sloučenin na Marsu je argumentem ve prospěch místního života. Mapa s vysokým rozlišením ukazuje, jak gravitace temné hmoty vtáhla normální hmotu do galaxií. Umělá inteligence se stává běžnou součástí českého zdravotnictví.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Levitující časové krystaly, které lze vzít do ruky

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Čip využívající spinové vlny funguje poprvé bez externích magnetů. Ohlášení podle nového zákona o kybernetické bezpečnosti provedlo přes 4800 organizací. Gartner předpovídá, že celosvětové výdaje na IT letos vzrostou o 10,8 %. Velké jazykové modely překonávají člověka i v emoční inteligenci. Rostoucí složitost cloudu má dopad na kybernetickou odolnost podniků.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Ohlášení podle nového zákona o kybernetické bezpečnosti provedlo přes 4800 organizací

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Kupte buď Windows 11 Pro, Office a jejich bundly nebo hry na tržišti Goodoffer24.com kde je vám toto všechno k dispozici. Žádné zkušební verze, ale doživotní licence!
articles.title: Levné klíče na Windows 11 a Office včetně bundlů a další software

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 7/2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Komunita kolem Linuxu From Scratch (LFS) vydala nové verze knih s návody na instalaci vlastního linuxového systému ze zdrojových kódů Linux From Scratch 13.0 a Beyond Linux From Scratch 13.0. Pouze se systemd.
articles.title: Linux From Scratch a Beyond Linux From Scratch 13.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová stabilní major verze 25.12 linuxové distribuce primárně určené pro routery a vestavěné systémy OpenWrt (Wikipedie). Jedná se o nástupce předchozí major verze 24.10. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání. Podporováno je více než 2200 zařízení.
articles.title: OpenWrt 25.12

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Na čem pracují vývojáři webového prohlížeče Ladybird (GitHub)? Byl publikován přehled vývoje za únor (YouTube). Odstraněn byl veškerý kód napsaný ve Swiftu. JavaScriptový engine LibJS byl reimplementován v Rustu.
articles.title: Vývoj webového prohlížeče Ladybird (02/2026)

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána verze 1.94.0 programovacího jazyka Rust (Wikipedie). Podrobnosti v poznámkách k vydání. Vyzkoušet Rust lze například na stránce Rust by Example. Zveřejněny byly výsledky průzkumu mezi vývojáři v programovacím jazyce Rust: 2025 State of Rust Survey Results.
articles.title: Rust 1.94.0. Výsledky průzkumu mezi vývojáři

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Google zveřejnil seznam 185 organizací přijatých do letošního Google Summer of Code (GSoC). Dle plánu se zájemci přihlašují od 16. do 31. března. Vydělat si mohou od 750 do 6600 dolarů. V Česku a na Slovensku je to 900 dolarů za malý, 1800 dolarů za střední a 3600 dolarů za velký projekt. Další informace v často kladených otázkách (FAQ). K dispozici jsou také statistiky z minulých let.
articles.title: Google Summer of Code 2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána únorová aktualizace aneb nová verze 1.110 editoru zdrojových kódů Visual Studio Code (Wikipedie). Přehled novinek i s náhledy a videi v poznámkách k vydání. Ve verzi 1.110 vyjde také VSCodium, tj. komunitní sestavení Visual Studia Code bez telemetrie a licenčních podmínek Microsoftu.
articles.title: Visual Studio Code a VSCodium 1.110

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Apple představil 13palcový MacBook Neo s čipem A18 Pro. V základní konfiguraci za 16 990 Kč.
articles.title: MacBook Neo

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Kalifornský zákon AB 1043 platný od 1. ledna 2027 vyžaduje, aby operační systémy požadovaly po uživatelích věk nebo datum narození a skrze API poskytovaly aplikacím informaci, zda je uživatel mladší 13 let, má 13 až 16 let, má 16 až 18 let nebo má alespoň 18 let. Vývojáři linuxových distribucí řeší, co s tím (Ubuntu, Fedora, …).
articles.title: Ověřování věku na úrovni operačního systému

articles.author: Petr Krčmář
articles.description: Konference LinuxDays 2026 proběhne o víkendu 3. a 4. října v Praze v areálu ČVUT v Dejvicích na FIT. Čekají vás desítky přednášek, workshopy, stánky a setkání se spoustou chytrých lidí.
articles.title: Konference LinuxDays 2026 proběhne o víkendu 3. a 4. října

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Nové verze webových prohlížečů Chrome a Firefox jsou vydávány každé 4 týdny. Aktuální verze Chrome je 145. Aktuální verze Firefoxu je 148. Od září přejde Chrome na dvoutýdenní cyklus vydávání. V kterém týdnu bude mít Chrome větší číslo verze než Firefox? 😀
articles.title: Slovní úloha: V kterém týdnu bude mít Chrome větší číslo verze než Firefox?

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: For those looking for a low-power, well-built small office / home office Linux server with interesting connectivity options, the ZimaBoard 2 is an interesting option that has been available for some months now and powered by the Intel N150 processor. Besides the interesting single board hardware and well built aluminum chassis, the offering is rounded out by being preloaded with ZimaOS as a Linux-based "personal cloud OS" to easily get hosting for your own SOHO server needs.
articles.title: ZimaBoard 2: An Interesting Intel-Powered Linux Home Mini Server

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Sent out today was this week's batch of Slab allocator fixes for the Linux 7.0 development kernel. Making this pull notable is fixing a "severe performance regression" with a ~64% performance drop having been noted in late February...
articles.title: Linux 7.0 Slab Fix On The Way For A "Severe Performance Regression"

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Patches were posted today to the Linux kernel mailing list for enabling a new feature called AMD CPPC Performance Priority as a new hardware feature being found with "future AMD processors".... Which given the timing of these patches, almost certainly means the upcoming Zen 6 processors...
articles.title: AMD CPPC Performance Priority Being Prepared For Linux - New Zen 6 Feature

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Canonical engineer Serkan Uygungelen published a post outlining some of the Intel Xeon CPU features to be supported by the upcoming Ubuntu 26.04 LTS release, some Xeon features already supported by the existing Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and some features only partially supported for still not having packaged user-space libraries/support within the Ubuntu archive...
articles.title: Intel Xeon Features To Be Supported By Ubuntu 26.04 LTS - Some Lacking User-Space Packages

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Four years ago Oracle announced Solaris CBE as the "Common Build Environment" version of Solaris 11.4. Wikigacha has turned Wikipedia into a card-collecting game, and at its core lies the packs.


Just like any good TCG and CCG, you can open packs to increase your collection. As you might have imagined, Wikigacha has one of the largest card collections I have ever seen in a video game. Every Wikipedia page is a card for you to collect.


Let's find out how you can get more packs.


Best way to open more packs in Wikigacha


Unlike microtransaction-infested games of modern times, Wikigacha is completely available for free. Every pack you open can be earned for free, and there's no way for you to spend any money to get extra packs.


Screenshot by Destructoid


This is how the pack system works inside the game.



At any given time, you can hold at most 10 packs.


Once the number of packs in your collection goes down below 10, a timer will start. You'll gain a pack every minute for free. You'll get your pack even if you close the game.


However, you can have at most 10 packs by this method. Once you've received the 10th pack, the timer will stop. It will resume when you open at least one of your packs.



If you want to min-max your collection, you'll need to login to the game every eight minutes or so and open as many packs as you can. If you open all the packs, you'll have 10 minutes before your storage is full.


There are additional ways to get more packs daily. The packs you earn from the daily tasks can bypass the limitation of 10.



Open five packs


Pull at least one SR+ card


Open Wikipedia once


Share your result


Watch one ad



You'll get two extra packs for every task that you complete. If you complete all the tasks, you'll receive ten additional packs. Hence, you'll rarely run out of packs to open in Wikigacha, and the best part is that you don't have to spend a dime.


While you get to open many packs on one hand, you'll also need to get plenty of cards to complete your collection and build competitive decks.

articles.description:
Who's up slaying their spire? Well, a whole heck of a lot of gamers, that's who.


Slay the Spire 2's early access launch yesterday can only be described as a tremendous success. The long-anticipated sequel to one of the earliest and most popular roguelikes on Steam had such high demand that it caused issues on the app's store yesterday.


Image via MegaCrit


But eventually, error codes subsides, and the numbers started pouring in. Less than a day later, it sits at Overwhelmingly Positive with almost 5,000 reviews, and a shocking all-time peak (reached within the past hour as of publishing) of over 430,000 concurrent players. That's enough to instantly make it the most-played Steam game with the "roguelike" tag, ever.


On day one, it skyrocketed past Elden Ring Nightreign's previous record of 313,593, and utterly dwarfing the high of the original Slay the Spire's peak of 57,025. And the rest of the list is also nothing to scoff at: Hades 2, Megabonk, Vampire Survivors, Risk of Rain 2, and on and on.


Slay the Spire 2 adds on to the original game's formula with new characters and cards, but also online co-op, giving every card battler fan a reason to gift their friends the game (or bug them until they buy it), marking uncharted territory for the series.


These kinds of numbers are a dream for any game dev, let alone an indie team like MegaCrit, who have taken years to work on and iterate the sequel. It's a feel-good story for sure, especially when those are in short supply these days. I'm hoping to see some sales numbers soon, but either way, that many players on an indie roguelike card battler is impressive no matter how you look at it.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Congrats to the team at MegaCrit, because if this is just the beginning, I can't wait to see how STS2 grows and improves over time with updates leading in to an eventual 1.0 full release.

How to co-op with friends in Slay the Spire 2


For starters, you and your buddies will need to own Slay the Spire 2 since there's no system of friends pass or anything similar. All of you must be added to Steam as friends. To play co-op, you'll need to invite your friends.



Load the game.

Select the type of game you want to host.

Now, you have to invite your friends from the Steam list.



Once your friend accepts your request, they will join your shared session. For co-op, the host must stay connected to the game at all times.


Does Slay the Spire 2 have matchmaking


While Slay the Spire 2 has co-op, there's no matchmaking. You can't host open sessions and play with strangers. However, you can add them as a friend on Steam and then send them the invite. This is a smart way to play with others if none of your friends are on Slay the Spire 2.

While this method isn't a guaranteed solution, it has helped me and many others in the community.


Slay the Spire 2 WWWW bug fix explained


The workaround for this bug appears to be pretty simple. You need to go to the game's main settings and change the language to English. You need to do this irrespective of what the default language is. The bug seems to appear randomly, and the cause remains unknown.


Screenshot by Destructoid


However, shifting to the English language appears to fix the problem. That said, the problem did recur for me once again when I restarted my game. Once I changed to English, the matter of WWWWs stopped. As of writing, there hasn't been a recurrence of this issue.


This isn't a permanent solution, and it's intended to work as a temporary fix until we can access the upcoming hotfix. The hotfix should be the permanent solution that will also allow you to play Slay the Spire 2 in a language of your preference (without being forced to use English to play).




The upcoming hotfix will also fix another bug that's related to Timeline unlocks. This bug can happen when you end certain multiplayer runs. If you're playing the single-player mode, this bug shouldn't be a worry for you at all.

Are you trying to acquire the massively popular Slay the Spire 2, attempting to buy something else on Steam, and just come across this cryptic error message?


You're not alone, because this happens often when a popular game launches on Steam. Having prior knowledge, here's what we know about how to fix the problem.


What is Steam error E502 L3?


Error E502 L3 points to a server-side issue, meaning it's a problem on Valve's end. To be more precise, this specific error code can pop up whenever you're logging in or browsing the Steam store. It also commonly refers to a problem in Steam's storefront, one likely related to the massive potential customer influx that hits the platform whenever Valve announces a hot new item.


Screenshot by Destructoid


The latest Steam Deck was one such item when it came out, as it immediately jumped to the top of Steam's wishlist charts upon its announcement. It happened again with Hollow Knight: Silksong in September 2025, and now it's happening with Slay the Spire 2, which has been one of the most anticipated and wishlisted sequels on the platform. Another hot game, Marathon, was released at the same time on the same day, so the servers are likely getting walloped.


As such, unless the problem has already been fixed and you'll just have to restart Steam for it to regain access to your transactions, there's nothing you can do other than wait and check SteamDB for updates on all sorts of server-side issues.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Valve was quick to acknowledge the issue the last time it got so widespread with a game like Hollow Knight: Silksong, so it'll likely be quick to get to it this time around as well.


Just sit tight and wait for issues to subside so you can purchase Slay the Spire 2. The issue should subside in due time.

The post How to fix Steam error E502 L3 affecting Slay the Spire 2 appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: How to fix Steam error E502 L3 affecting Slay the Spire 2

Marathon is now out on PCs and consoles worldwide, but PC users who have purchased the game on Steam have run into a problem.


Several players worldwide have reported instances when they've been unable to launch their game from Steam. This is despite their PC meeting all the requirements and having an active internet connection.


Thankfully, there's an easy fix to the problem.


How to solve Marathon not opening on Steam bug


The problem at hand appears to happen only when you're using Steam to play Marathon. Sometimes, the game will refuse to launch at all. A session will start, but the game closes abruptly. Alternatively, the game might not even run properly when you're opening it from Steam.




When the problem happens, restarting your Steam client seems to be a temporary fix that you can try.



Close your Steam client if it's open.


Click on the bottom right corner of your taskbar.


Find the Steam logo, and right-click on it.


You'll find an option to exit Steam.


Close the application, and then restart Steam. If you have time on your hands, you can also reboot your PC.



This should solve the problem, but it could reappear. If that happens, your only solution is to restart Steam once again and then launch Marathon. Additionally, this method should also work if you're looking to purchase Steam but are unable to do so. Restarting Steam should allow you to purchase and download the game that will allow you to then jump into Tau Ceti IV.


Launch day has brought a few other problems as well. Players are currently unable to redeem their Digital Edition bonuses. There are also instances where a few have been unable to obtain their Server Slam Twitch drops. These problems should hopefully subside quickly, but there are a few workarounds you can try out.

The post How to fix Marathon not opening on Steam appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: How to fix Marathon not opening on Steam

With millions of monthly visits, P-stream was a popular pirate streaming portal, providing free access to movies and TV series. The project launched in 2024 following the shutdown of a similar service, movie-web, which was eventually shut down by legal pressure from Hollywood. Today, P-Stream follows the same path, taking down the website, after a DMCA subpoena from the MPA/ACE targeted Cloudflare.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

With the FIFA World Cup coming to North America this summer, this year's report puts a special focus on live sports broadcast piracy. The USTR hopes that by naming these platforms, operators and foreign governments will take appropriate action.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Lists Notorious Piracy Threats, With Focus on Sports Streaming

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

YggTorrent, the largest francophone torrent community, has shut down permanently following a devastating hack. The cyberattack compromised YggTorrent's infrastructure, wiped key information, and drained the site's crypto wallets. The hacker publicly published the site's data online in a massive 11+ GB archive, noting that this could be of interest to law enforcement. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: YggTorrent Shuts Down After Hack, Leak and Stolen Crypto

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

Anna’s Archive lost its .li domain a few hours ago, likely due to legal pressure. The shadow library's domain name was outright deleted instead of suspended. Whether the domain registrar or registry is responsible is unknown, but the latter seems more plausible. Anna's Archive was briefly down to one remaining domain name, but several new ones were swiftly added.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Loses .LI Domain As Legal Pressure Mounts

The defendant tried various unorthodox methods to make the case go away, including a demand for money from the movie companies, but these efforts all failed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Obtained in cooperation with anti-piracy coalition ACE, the order compels Indian ISPs and globally operating domain registrars to block or suspend the listed sites. Thus far, however, the results appear to be mixed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UEFA Secures Pirate Site Blocking and (Global) Domain Suspension Order in India

Adult entertainment company Flava Works is trying to identify the alleged pirates, who allegedly shared their content via a private torrent tracker. While Google previously complied in a similar case, it has now raised First Amendment concerns.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

One company in particular filed 838 inactionable reports in six months, reportedly targeting content that doesn't even exist on the platform. According to Automattic, these automated notices are almost certainly an effort to maximize revenue.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: WordPress.com Flags Concerning Spike in AI-Generated DMCA Takedowns

In a new filing, Strike 3 claims that a Meta employee allegedly deleted over 9 terabytes of torrented files. Meta notes that this claim, which originates from an unrelated case, is mischaracterized and irrelevant. Regardless of the outcome of these and other ongoing discovery disputes, both parties aim for a trial in 2028. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta Employee Deleted 9TB of Torrented Files, Adult Film Producers Claim

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

Importantly, the latter two are not required to block content through their DNS resolvers, which is likely the result of an ongoing legal challenge.
Notably, DNS providers are spared this time around, likely reflecting the ongoing legal fallout from earlier Belgian orders that drove Cisco's OpenDNS to temporarily abandon the country.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Belgian Pirate Site Blocking Order Targets Cloudflare and Google, But Not Their DNS

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

In two separate cases, the Paris Judicial Court rejected the company's arguments, including violations of the EU's Open Internet Regulation, technical complications, and overblocking concerns. While this is a disappointing outcome for the VPN provider, it likely won't be the last legal battle.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ProtonVPN Fights French Pirate Site Blockades, But Court Rejects Overblocking Fears

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:

In a detailed submission to the U.S. government, Ukraine outlines various IP reforms, including proposed legislation that would pave the way for pirate site blocking. Ironically, the plans could put Ukraine ahead of the United States, which still lacks a 'no fault' site-blocking regime of its own.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Ukraine Paves the Way for Pirate Site Blocking, Despite Ongoing War

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

The lawsuit, filed in a New York federal court, is coordinated by the International Broadcaster Coalition Against Piracy. It accuses the Moroccan IPTV operators of widespread copyright infringement and seeks more than $21 million in potential damages.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Sues ‘DMTN IPTV’ in $21m Piracy Lawsuit; Operator Posed as Breaking Bad Creator

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

The "dynamic" injunction compels NordVPN and ProtonVPN to intervene, similar to local ISPs. But with both companies operating outside EU jurisdiction with privacy-centric business models, it remains unclear if and how the order will actually be enforced.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Spanish Court Orders ProtonVPN and NordVPN to Block Pirate Football Streams

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:

Spanish-language veteran HDFull is targeted in both, with ACE seeking to unmask several people connected to the site and its popular Discord server, which was abruptly shut down.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE Targets Pirate Streaming Site ‘HDFull’ Through Cloudflare and Discord Subpoenas

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
More than two years ago, Amazon sued a network of websites that sold pirated DVDs of Prime Video exclusives such as The Rings of Power and The Boys. The defendants, believed to be based in China, never showed up in court. This week, a California federal judge awarded Amazon $6 million in damages and granted a broad domain transfer request, targeting registrars and registries. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Amazon Wins $6 Million in Damages Against Pirated DVD Stores, Plus Domain Takeovers

articles.title: South Korea Seeks Multilingual Talent to Hunt Down K-Content Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

An Argentine court has expanded the crackdown on pirate IPTV services Magis TV and Xuper TV, blocking more than 70 domains, while ordering Google to disable sideloaded Android apps. Notably, the enforcement action follows shortly after a new US-Argentina trade deal was signed.

articles.description: Řemeslně a výtvarně OK, vtípky pro malé děti fungují, ale scénář je opravdu zoufalý. Jde o sérii klasických disneyovských minizápletek ("Chraň přírodu", "Buď sám sebou", "Obětuj se pro kamaráda", "Bojuj proti zlu"), které jsou propojeny nepříliš smysluplnými "Deus ex machina" náhodami a všemocnými vynálezy. Mnoho potenciálně zajímavých témat je zběžně nakousnuto a okamžitě zapomenuto. Jako celovečerní film to moc nefunguje a určitě by to bylo lepší jako televizní seriál. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Na skok do divočiny [Hoppers] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Film se dvěma výbornými hereckými výkony (Dano a Law), který selhává dvěma zásadními způsoby: 1) Jako rekonstrukce historických událostí vzbuzuje dojem, že Rusko a Putin byli k většině svých zvěrstev donuceni zlým zbytkem světa, nemohli se vlastně zachovat jinak a jediný "hlas vyspělé západní demokracie" (Wright) působí jako vyšinutý konspirační teoretik. 2) Smyšlený příběh hlavního smyšleného hrdiny (Dano) je veskrze nezajímavý a zbytečně natahovaný. Putin (Law) je mnohem zajímavější, ale poprvé se ve filmu objeví až po hodině. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Čarodej z Kremlu [The Wizard of the Kremlin] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Prvních 15-20 minut je naprosto famózních a kdyby takhle vypadal celý film, nerozpakoval bych se dát mu absolutní hodnocení. Bohužel, zbývajících 80 minut je "jenom" velmi zručně sestříhaný (a do značné míry "zrekonstruovaný") záznam několika koncertů, jehož vychutnání bude velmi záviset na tom, do jaké míry je Elvis Presley vaším šálkem kávy. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Natočit "Kmen Andromeda" jako komedii je zajímavý nápad, ale jeho filmová realizace znatelně drhne a trvá téměř hodinu, než se film konečně trochu rozjede. Na vině je především režisér, pod jehož taktovkou značná část humoru nefunguje tak dobře, jak si scenárista představoval. Škoda, že nerežíroval třeba Sam Raimi, protože potenciál námětu byl značný. (Ilča 50 %)

Bohužel je ale celý film naprosto mimo co se týče hereckých výkonů a režie, což mě překvapilo, protože jsem si myslel, že Andy Fehu dobře zvládá filmové řemeslo. (Ilča 10 %)

It was discovered that Qt did not correctly handle OpenSSL's error queue.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
This issue was only addressed in Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-13962)

It was discovered that Qt incorrectly handled certain XBM image files. If a
user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PPM
file, a remote attacker could cause Qt to crash, resulting in a denial of
service. This issue was only addressed in Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-17507)

It was discovered that Qt did not correctly handle executing specific
binaries. If a user or automated system were tricked into executing a
binary at a specific file path, an attacker could cause a denial of
service or execute arbitrary code. This issue was only addressed in
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2022-25255)

It was discovered that Qt did not correctly handle certain integer
arithmetic. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service. This issue was only addressed in Ubuntu 18.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. (CVE-2023-51714)

It was discovered that Qt did not correctly handle certain encrypted
connections. An attacker could possibly use this issue to leak sensitive
information. This issue was only addressed in Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
(CVE-2024-39936)

It was discovered that Bleach did not properly sanitize URI attributes
containing character entities. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to construct a URI with a disallowed scheme that would bypass
sanitization, leading to cross-site scripting. This issue only affected
Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2018-7753)

Yaniv Nizry discovered that Bleach was vulnerable to a mutation
cross-site scripting issue when sanitizing HTML with the noscript tag
and a raw tag in the allowed tags list. An attacker could possibly
use this issue to inject malicious content, leading to cross-site
scripting. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-6802)

Yaniv Nizry discovered that Bleach was vulnerable to a mutation
cross-site scripting issue when sanitizing HTML with RCDATA together
with svg or math tags in the allowed tags list. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to inject malicious content, leading to
cross-site scripting. (CVE-2020-6816)

It was discovered that Bleach incorrectly handled parsing of style
attributes when sanitizing HTML. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to perform a regular expression denial of service, leading to
excessive resource consumption. (CVE-2020-6817)

Yaniv Nizry and Michał Bentkowski discovered that Bleach was vulnerable
to a mutation cross-site scripting issue when sanitizing HTML with
certain combinations of allowed tags. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to inject malicious content, leading to cross-site scripting.
(CVE-2021-23980)

corresponding fix for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS,

 It was discovered that NSS incorrectly handled memory when performing
 certain GHASH operations. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause
 NSS to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute

Michael Randrianantenaina discovered that calculating the linear size of a
DDS file could overflow on 32-bit systems. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. This
issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 24.04
LTS. (CVE-2025-2760)

Michael Randrianantenaina discovered that GIMP did not perform any bounds
checking when calculating an offset into XWD Colormaps. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary
code. (CVE-2025-10934)

It was discovered that GIMP's PNM loader did not sufficiently check that
the image could fit within the allocated memory, which could cause GIMP to
read or write out-of-bounds. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-14422)

It was discovered that maliciously-crafted TGA files could cause memory
corruption and leave GIMP in an inconsistent state. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary
code. (CVE-2025-48797)

free the same memory region twice, or access an already freed address. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or
execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-48798)

use this issue to cause QEMU to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

operations. An remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause QEMU

could be made to write out of bounds. An attacker inside the guest could
possibly use this issue to cause QEMU to crash, resulting in a denial of

Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 25.10. (CVE-2025-12464)

not limit the length of a certain path input. An attacker inside the guest

24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 25.10. (CVE-2025-14876)
